content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the IIT Roorkee recruitment is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee is recruiting for the posts of Program Coordinator and Project Associate / Research Associate / Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the Program Coordinator and Project Associate positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Program Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Program Coordinator post is a PhD with 6 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate position ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the IIT Roorkee office in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature, as indicated in the recruitment notification.
